value.rationale: A quotient that bijects idempotents need not preserve their commutation graph. The reflection theorem identifies the entire higher commuting-configuration structure of two substantially different natural semigroups, while the first triple-series calculation provides a natural exact all-size invariant and an explicit 13-state certificate rather than a mere rename of known pair totals.
